name: Hosea
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The word of the Lord came unto Hosea the son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea

points: God told Hosea to take a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms because the land had committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord. The marriage is a picture of what Israel did to him, joining to the gods of the other nations.
The Lord tells Hosea to go take a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms, for the land has committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord.

cases.name: Hosea the prophet
cases.charge: Taking a wife of whoredoms at the Lord’s command as a sign against Israel; prophesying the scattering and the return
cases.preview: In the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, the Lord told Hosea to take a wife of whoredoms, because the land had left the Lord for other lovers, and he took Gomer and named her children Jezreel,…
